pool.text: Explorer Jacques Cartier established the earliest known French settlement, Fort Charlesbourg-Royal.
Explorer Samuel de Champlain founded a French settlement at the location.
English privateers led by David Kirke captured Quebec City.
King Charles I agreed to return captured lands following negotiations.
The population reached 550 people living in 70 houses.
English attackers assaulted Quebec City, which was successfully defended.
British forces captured Quebec during the French and Indian War.
France officially ceded New France, including the city, to Britain.
Quebec City was made the capital of Lower Canada.
Construction of the Citadelle of Quebec began amid American attack fears.
The First Quebec Conference was held with Franklin D.
Churchill and Roosevelt attended the Second Quebec Conference.
Twelve former towns were annexed by Quebec City on January 1st.
L'Ancienne-Lorette and Saint-Augustin-de-Desmaures were reconstituted as separate municipalities after a referendum.
The city celebrated its 400th anniversary with funded festivities.
Quebec City re-organized its boroughs, reducing the total from 8 to 6.
A student carried out a mass shooting at the Quebec Islamic Cultural Centre.
The unemployment rate dropped to 3.8% in June.
Police arrested a medieval-costumed man armed with a Japanese sword.
Bruno Marchand was elected as the current mayor.
